Hi Samantha —

Thanks for initiating onboarding with Redwood. Procurement is ready to issue PO #R-2027-9876, but we have a few outstanding tax/identity items that are holding the PO in a provisional state. To complete vendor setup we need the following: 

- Completed, signed W-8BEN-E (PDF).
- A certified copy of the EIN letter (IRS CP575) or an official government tax transcript that ties the EIN to your legal entity name.
- Clarification on legal entity vs. DBA (if the W-8 uses a DBA, please provide formation docs showing the DBA relationship).
- Banking details on company letterhead for ACH/wire (bank letter).

If you can provide scanned copies (PDF is fine) or a notarized affidavit linking the DBA to the legal entity, we can clear the PO hold the same day. 

Uploading into the vendor portal is fine, or you can reply with attachments to this thread. If anything will take longer than 48 hours, let us know and we'll discuss interim options.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — 

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

Laura / Samantha —

Thanks for the fast response, Samantha. The EIN letter is helpful but procurement compliance requires a clear link between the legal entity on tax docs (Oxbridge Solutions, Inc.) and the invoice/legal name that Redwood will pay (Oxbridge Labs). The acceptable items are (one of the following):

- Notarized affidavit on company letterhead stating the DBA relationship, or
- Certificate of Assumed Name / DBA filing from the jurisdiction where you operate, or
- Articles of Incorporation plus a board resolution showing the trade name, or
- A recent bank letter that matches legal name and shows the DBA (bank letter on company headed paper).

If you can provide a notarized affidavit and the bank letter, we should be able to clear the PO. If you'd like, we can accept a notarized affidavit first and follow up with formation docs within five business days.

Karthik Iyer
Vendor Risk & Compliance
Redwood Inference
